investigator.method: Bounded, single unauthenticated Level-1 PASSIVE_STATIC GET (curl, descriptive User-Agent, redirects followed, 20s timeout, no retry, no authentication, no CAPTCHA/challenge bypass, no browser) against the venue's official_website (falling back to official_programme_url where noted), as part of BEATMAPPED-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01 batch 6 of 7.

probe_history.reason: A single unauthenticated Level-1 static GET against https://www.victoriapalacetheatre.co.uk/whats-on retained enough real evidence (event/programme listing content, title/meta tags, and structured data where present) to reach an honest, evidenced REJECT decision without needing to escalate to Level 2/3/4.

identity.notes: The retained page's own <title> ('What's On at Victoria Palace Theatre in London's West End') and retained Organization JSON-LD ('Delfont Mackintosh Theatres') directly self-identify the domain as the venue's own official site.

site_classification.platform: WordPress-based Delfont Mackintosh Theatres site emitting an Organization block and a single long-running Event (a theatrical production run) via JSON-LD.

venue_location.notes: Discovery evidence reports Victoria Street 79, SW1E 5EA, London; the retained excerpt did not itself restate a street address for this bounded probe (it cites the operator's separate head-office address instead).

reasons: The retained page's own JSON-LD Event and 'Currently Playing at Victoria Palace Theatre' hero section both show a single long-running theatrical production, 'Hamilton' (booking until 13 March 2027) — a West End book-musical run, not a concert, gig, or DJ/club night.

Matching the policy's guidance that Victoria Palace Theatre is a West-End style theatre likely to be rejected absent real evidence of substantially live-music/concert programming, this bounded probe found only the single ongoing musical-theatre production and no concert/gig listing.

evidence.description: Retained, bounded, genuine excerpts (contiguous literal substrings) of the actual HTTP response body from a single unauthenticated GET, plus response metadata (status/content-type/title); JSON wrapper around literal excerpt strings, so not byte-faithful as a whole file.
evidence.method: curl -L (redirects followed); descriptive User-Agent; unauthenticated GET; 20-second timeout; no retry; no browser/JS execution.
